CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer can log in during checkout using valid credentials
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to the checkout login step on NAP and MRP. Enter a valid registered email and password. Submit the login form.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Login succeeds and user is navigated to the shipping address step.
The anonymous cart is preserved and associated with the logged-in session.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Checkout login shows error when credentials are invalid
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On the checkout login step, submit the form with an incorrect password for a known account. Observe the page response.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
An error notification is displayed.
The customer remains on the login step and is not forwarded to shipping.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Email field validates format before submission
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Enter a malformed email address (e.g. missing @) in the email field and attempt to submit.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Inline field validation error is displayed.
Form does not submit until a correctly formatted email address is entered.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Anonymous cart is transferred to authenticated session on login
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Add items to cart as an anonymous user, proceed to checkout, log in at the login step. Check cart contents after login.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Cart items added before login are visible in the post-login cart.
Session continues seamlessly to the shipping address step.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: All required registration form fields are displayed
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Navigate to the checkout registration step on NAP and MRP. Inspect the form visually.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Email, password, title dropdown, first name, and last name fields are all present.
T&C link and consent checkbox are visible.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Successful registration navigates customer to shipping address step
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Complete all registration fields with valid data and submit. Observe the post-registration navigation on both NAP and MRP.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Account is created successfully.
Customer is navigated directly to the shipping address step without additional prompts.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Duplicate email address registration is rejected with an error
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Attempt to register with an email address that is already associated with an existing account.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
An error message is displayed indicating the email is already in use.
Customer remains on the registration step and is not progressed.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: T&C consent checkbox is present and must be checked to submit
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Attempt to submit the registration form without checking the T&C checkbox. Then check it and resubmit.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Form submission without T&C consent is blocked and an error is shown.
With checkbox checked, submission proceeds normally.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Registration form displays inline field errors for invalid inputs
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Submit the registration form with invalid or empty required fields (e.g. blank first name, weak password). Observe field-level feedback.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Each invalid field displays an inline error message.
Form does not submit until all required fields pass validation.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Guest checkout email field is empty on first-time entry
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Start a fresh checkout session as a guest (no prior cart email stored). Navigate to the guest email step.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The email input field is empty.
Customer can enter their email and proceed to the address form.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Guest form pre-fills previously entered email and persists updates
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Enter an email as a guest and proceed to the address form. Navigate back to the start of checkout, re-select guest option, and open the guest email form. Update the email and navigate forward and back again.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
On re-entry, the email field shows the previously entered address.
After updating the email, the new address is shown on subsequent back-navigation.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Brand-specific design differences in login/registration form layout or error messaging
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Execute the login and registration flows side-by-side on NAP and MRP acceptance environments. Compare field labels, error messages, CTA text, and visual layout.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Forms are functionally identical; visual differences are limited to brand styling. Error messages are consistent and not brand-specific in wording.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Medium — inconsistent error messaging across brands degrades customer support and brand experience.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: QA comment confirms both brands pass; layout delta not documented.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Cart items from anonymous session are not lost or duplicated on login
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Add 2+ items to cart anonymously, proceed to checkout, log in, verify cart contents at the shipping step. Also test with a logged-in account that already has saved items.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Anonymous cart merges cleanly into the authenticated session. No items are lost or duplicated.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: High — lost cart items on login would directly harm conversion.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: QA comment notes cart is loaded post-login; explicit merge-conflict scenario not documented.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Wishlist items are associated with newly registered account after checkout registration
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: As a guest with items in wishlist and cart, complete checkout registration. Post-registration, navigate to the wishlist page and verify items are preserved.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Wishlist items are associated with the new account. Cart continuity is maintained into shipping step.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Medium — wishlist loss after registration would reduce engagement.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: AC states wishlistId is sent in registration mutation; no explicit QA confirmation of outcome.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Guest email pre-fill does not interfere with a subsequent login flow selection
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Enter a guest email, navigate to address form, navigate back, select login instead of guest. Verify that the login form does not pre-populate with the guest email.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Switching from guest to login mode shows a clean login form. Previously entered guest email does not bleed into the login email field.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Low — could cause confusion but does not block purchase.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: No specific AC or QA coverage for mode-switching scenario.
